family_reports.body: My life revolves around soul crushing court ordered abuse. My child has been legally…
My children’s childhood was stolen from them. They were taken on false allegations over…
When systems meant to protect children fail to conduct a full and fair investigation…

public_comments.comment_text: Never met with the primary custodial parent of 12 years nor was that parent given the opportunity to submit evidence. She knew no one in the hallway when we finally got a hearing after the children were removed. She didn’t know the children’s teachers, coaches or counselors. She even attempted to intimidate a witness in the hallway, the school counselor. She then recommended the children and family to see a therapist that was not properly licensed.
